// Host a anchors/counts: 00:00=2, 00:05=4, 00:05+tick=3, 00:20=1.
// Host b has independent single-match windows. No expiry is an evaluation anchor.
let Events = datatable(Timestamp:datetime, Host:string, Marker:string) [

 datetime(2026-01-01T00:00:00), "b", "match",
 datetime(2026-01-01T00:05:00.0000001), "b", "match"
];
let gt_fraction = () {
let SourceMatchArrivals = union (Events
| where Marker =~ "match"
| project EventTime_1 = todatetime(["Timestamp"]), GroupHost = ["Host"])
| where isnotnull(EventTime_1) and isnotempty(GroupHost)
| summarize SourceMatchCount = count() by EventTime_1, GroupHost;
union (SourceMatchArrivals
| project GroupHost, CountBoundaryTime = EventTime_1, CountBoundaryOrder = 0, SourceMatchDelta = SourceMatchCount),
(SourceMatchArrivals
| project GroupHost, CountBoundaryTime = EventTime_1 + 5m, CountBoundaryOrder = 1, SourceMatchDelta = -SourceMatchCount)
// Arrivals evaluate before equal-time expirations; expirations never create matches.
| sort by GroupHost asc, CountBoundaryTime asc, CountBoundaryOrder asc
| extend EventCount = row_cumsum(SourceMatchDelta, GroupHost != prev(GroupHost))
| where CountBoundaryOrder == 0
| where EventCount > 2.5
| project WindowStart = CountBoundaryTime - 5m, WindowEnd = CountBoundaryTime, ["Host"] = GroupHost, EventCount
};
